scenarios.name: Navigate through a staged separator with arrow keys

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target
the target contains "Cancel Sketch", a separator, and "Finish Sketch" in that order
the user selects "Cancel Sketch" in the target list
the staged rows remain in their original order
the customization dialog closes without applying the staged entries
